_comment: An IRIS capture staged by the owner, 2026-09-20. The filename is kept as the capture produced it; the `-info` suffix marks a full item record, matching the wpr-rdo capture's own convention rather than a new one.

files.note: The DSpace FULL ITEM RECORD. Carries what no local inference could: the collection the item sits in, the handle, three ISBNs, seven MeSH terms, a language-version relation, and EIGHT bitstreams where this repository holds one.

The PUBLICATION ITSELF — the ORIGINAL bitstream this item's catalogue node names, and the bytes `library/9789241548960-eng` was derived from (its `structure.json` records this same sha256). Relocated here 2026-09-21 from `cat-harness/uploads/` (bean `yl5w`, issue #663): #477 moved `library/` into `who-iris/` and left the sources behind, so the catalogue's `localPath` claimed bytes that were one instance over. Recorded in this intake rather than only in the catalogue, because this file describes what is IN this directory.
